ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the C1-1,
Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 28-G
in the area bound by:

West 111" Street; a line 49.5 feet west of and parallel to South Aberdeen Street; the
alley next south of and parallel to West 111" Street; and a line 174.15 feet west of and
parallel to South Aberdeen Street,

to those of a RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

etal

Ronnie L. Mosley
Alderman, 21% Ward

Common Address:
1107-1117 W. 111th Street
